conflict_synopsis.core_view: AU 2Y has overshot the live AONIA path after the housing channel already started to bite; fade that local rates overshoot, not CA-US 2Y and not AUDNZD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Australian housing transmission versus a 2Y print through the live AONIA Mar-2027 terminal of 4.86.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Live AONIA Mar-2027 implied rate through 4.999, or housing/activity evidence that the tightening channel is no longer biting.

paper_capital.rationale: Funded seats pay 5.00% ACT/365 on the full $100m whether flat or not, so cash is not a free alternative. Empty seed book, no open risk. 2Y duration is short, so $25m is a moderate slice of the $100m allocation intended to monetize a giveback toward the live AONIA Mar-2027 implied 4.86 from the 4.999 AU 2Y print over 4-8 weeks. No executable broker mark is in the packet; if the book engine cannot represent AU 2Y, the parent should record execution_blocked/HOLD rather than invent a price.

remit: fade statistically or fundamentally stretched market moves when reversal conditions exist
stance_summary: Crowded post-hike extrapolation has pushed AU 2Y through the live AONIA path even as the housing channel is already biting. Fade that sovereign overshoot in duration, not because the percentile is extreme, but because the policy-path anchor and a weakening transmission mechanism now disagree with the priced extra tightness. Do not fade CA-US 2Y: that historical extreme is still anchored to the overnight policy gap. Do not fade AUDNZD without NZ yields.

catalysts: Oct/Nov AONIA cash-futures window (Oct implied 4.565 with OI 21752 / volume 4450) versus a 2Y still through Mar-2027 4.86.
Further Australian housing/transaction/stamp-duty evidence that transmission is still tightening financial conditions.
Any cooling in the AU inflation gauge from 82 toward activity/consumer/labor (54/48/50) that lets 2Y close the gap to the cash-futures strip.

context_build.causal_mechanism: FACT: RBA tightening is already hitting the housing stock-flow channel (NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% YoY in August, transaction volumes -18%, Sydney and Melbourne home values more than 7% below peak). INFERENCE: once that channel is biting, additional 2Y cheapening that prices through the live AONIA terminal is late-cycle extrapolation of global tightening, not required local policy. The trade tests whether AU 2Y mean-reverts toward the AONIA/ASX cash-futures path as housing/activity confirm transmission. UNKNOWN: the next RBA decision date and any unpublished RBA reaction function beyond the futures path.

CFTC TFF net asset-manager/dealer/leveraged positions are null across G10 and Treasuries; only open interest is usable. AUD OI is at a 1y/3y extreme with a large weekly build; US 2Y OI is only 24.0th percentile 1y (4,433,736 contracts). Paper books are empty $100m seeds with no overnight positions. INFERENCE: elevated AUD futures intensity can amplify an AUD-side reversal if housing bites, but it is not a signed crowding map and is not the AU 2Y thesis. UNKNOWN: dealer/leveraged net on ACGB or ASX cash futures beyond the listed ASX OI/volume on front AONIA contracts.

historical_reference.regime_differences: FACT: current 2Y level 4.999 is above all four analog levels, and live AONIA still prices +51bp to Mar-2027. 2022-01 and 2023-05 were early/mid hiking into rising inflation with no packet housing-collapse analog. 2025-12-22 is the most dangerous analog because it continued from a closer yield and a similar 1m move. INFERENCE: 2022-09-28 is the closest mechanism analog (tightening already in the market, subsequent giveback) but the yield level was 142bp lower and today's energy-shock/global-tightening overlay (desk 18 Sep, BoJ 1.25%) was not that regime. Do not pool 2022 start-of-cycle analogs with a housing-transmission fade.

independent_checks: Policy-path check (live): AONIA 4.35 and ASX cash futures to Mar-2027 at 4.86 versus AU 2Y 4.999. Oct futures are actively traded (OI 21752, volume 4450); Dec volume 2, so back-end conviction on the strip is thin relative to the 2Y print.

Housing micro versus inflation gauge: stamp duty -24% YoY, volumes -18%, dwelling values >7% off peak versus AU inflation temperature 82 and activity/consumer/labor 54/48/50. Real-side gauges do not confirm the inflation-led 2Y overshoot.

Cross-market: AUDUSD 76.4th percentile 1y is not the stretch; AUDCAD and AUDNZD at 99.8th 1y and 5y are the FX extreme. NZ yields unavailable, so AUDNZD is not a rates-confirmed fade. CFTC AUD futures OI 493141 on 2026-09-15 is 99.0th percentile 1y / 99.7th 3y (z 3.61 / 5.42) with +37673 weekly contracts; net trader-class direction is null, so this is intensity not a signed long-AUD count.

Rejected RV fade: CA-US 2Y at -140bp is 3.8th percentile 1y / 4.3rd 5y, but Fed 3.75-4.00 versus CORRA 2.29 is a 146-171bp overnight gap, so the 2Y spread is anchored to policy not historically orphaned. US 2Y 4.76 versus delayed SOFR Dec 4.1975 / Aug-2028 terminal 4.6025 looks stretched, but the SOFR chain is eSignal-delayed and is inferior as an AU-local catalyst to live AONIA plus housing.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN: AU inflation temperature 82, AONIA path already prices about +51bp by Mar-2027, Fed hike was >90% priced into 16 Sep, August US CPI had already kept the tightening bias intact. NEW/LOCAL: 16 Sep housing evidence that the tightening channel is biting in volumes, stamp duty and prices. NEW/GLOBAL: hike delivery itself, BoJ 1.25%, and the 18 Sep desk claim that tightening is broadening. INFERENCE: the known hawkish facts can explain why AONIA prices +21.5bp by October; they do not by themselves explain why the 2Y sovereign prints 14bp through the Mar-2027 AONIA terminal after housing has already rolled over. UNKNOWN: whether 16 Sep AU yields already fully incorporated that day's housing article (yield as_of and article date coincide).
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: INFERENCE: the market is treating 'global tightening broadens' plus AU inflation gauge 82 as permission to hold 2Y through the live AONIA terminal. Disagree: the priced extra tightness is the overshoot. Housing volumes/prices/stamp duty are the weakening mechanism; activity 54, consumer 48 and labor 50 are the independent real-side check that inflation 82 is not being validated by demand. Anchor is AONIA/ASX cash futures, not the 99th percentile.

INFERENCE: the 2Y requires either more hikes than the live cash-futures strip, a persistent term/credit premium over AONIA, or a refusal to treat housing as a binding constraint. 6m bank bills at 5.07 (17-Sep-2026) sit above the 2Y; official bill-minus-OIS is unavailable_cross_vintage and must not be used as a current OIS substitute.

trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if the live AONIA/ASX path lifts the Mar-2027 implied rate through the packet AU 2Y print of 4.999, or if subsequent housing/activity evidence stops confirming that the tightening channel is biting while AU 2Y fails to give back toward that path. Do not treat a further percentile extreme alone as invalidation.

The percentile (99th 1y / 99.8th 5y) only flags the stretch; the mispricing is 2Y versus the observable policy path given a working tightening channel.

trade.thesis: FACT: AU 2Y 4.999 (16 Sep) sits through live AONIA Mar-2027 implied 4.86 and 27bp through Dec implied 4.725, while NSW stamp duty, volumes and dwelling prices show the RBA housing channel already biting. INFERENCE: global-tightening extrapolation after the Fed/BoJ events is holding AU 2Y too far through a cash-futures path that already prices +51bp of extra tightness. Mean-reversion is toward the AONIA strip, not to a statistical mean. UNKNOWN: executable ACGB/ASX levels, RBA meeting specifics, and whether 16 Sep yields already digested the housing copy. Separate from this trade, CA-US 2Y at -140bp is not a fade: it is still consistent with the overnight policy gap.
why_now: Housing evidence on 2026-09-16 documents the tightening channel biting (stamp duty -24% YoY, volumes -18%, prices >7% off peak) while AU 2Y as of the same date prints through the live AONIA terminal.

Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% was >90% priced into 16 Sep and has now been delivered; BoJ to 1.25% on 17 Sep is additional known global duration supply. That is when local housing should start to dominate AU 2Y, not when 2Y should push further through AONIA.
Paper book is an empty $100m seed paying 5% vig; no existing AU duration to hold. Oct AONIA (implied 4.565, heavy OI/volume) is the near catalyst window.
